policy.oracle: Expectations transcribed from REXX instructions and source literals/comments; execution output is never an acceptance oracle. Explicit diagnostic multiplicities and ONLY restrictions are enforced; other required diagnostics are minima, permitting cascading errors only where indicated. Extra diagnostics retained in results.
policy.profiles: 32-bit cells are authoritative for the historic suite. The selected checked/release profile explicitly overrides original -d flags with d2/d0; original -O flags remain unless --optimization overrides them, with O2 as the default. d0 excludes runtime cases whose oracle depends on assertions or bounds; unchecked invalid-memory cases never execute.
policy.normalization: CRLF→LF; trim line boundaries; collapse horizontal whitespace; remove only ANSI SGR color sequences emitted by canonical amxcons VT100 backend; strip only pawnrun host Return value footer. Raw bytes are hashed and retained. Numeric tolerance only for the two declared floating display cases.
policy.unselected_execution: Compile-only cases stay compile-only, including interactive Fibonacci/menu/state fixtures and intentional infinite loops. Runtime stdin is closed; wall/CPU/memory/output limits apply to every process.
policy.source_preservation: Original suite copied byte-for-byte into individual scratch workspaces before each compile/run; no source edits. Explicit adaptations omit two removed CLI options while retaining their original argv and documenting semantics. Removed caret-escape customization remains unsupported, with CLI rejection checked independently of its unfulfilled original oracle.
policy.known_defect: Only exact source-derived runtime variants or separately minimized compiler signatures qualify as known_upstream_defect. Version-specific diagnostic additions are documented_oracle_drift. Neither counts as all_requested_verified. The original oracle result and reasons remain in every step.
policy.instrumentation: FORTIFY cases63/97 remain unsupported_harness. Self-attestation is rejected: the --fortify flag cannot prove active instrumentation or leak reporting. A future instrumentation integration requires an independently failing positive control and compiler/configuration provenance.

known_variants.reason: The fixture expects31.018, but3.142³ is exactly31.018579288, whose nearest-thousandth rounding is31.019. Stable amxfixed.c n_fmul adds half the divisor before division; n_fpower adds an extra precision digit and rounds before unscaling:3142→31420→98722→310185→31019. REXX test61 documents an old off-by0.001 problem, but its31.018 target is stale; this is an explicit oracle drift, not evidence that the current arithmetic is defective.

known_compile_defects.reason: Stable4.1.7483 compiler built with PAWN_CELL_SIZE32 aborts at sc4.c:729 fillarray(size>0) instead of issuing error009 for an oversized array. Minimal reproducer: main() { new big[2000000000]; big[0] = 10; }. sc1.c calc_arraysize calculates a byte-limit product in cell arithmetic and declloc multiplies the cell count by pc_cellsize again before fillarray; oversized values bypass the intended diagnostic and violate the positivity assertion. Bounded compiler-only probes reproduce at O0–O3; no produced bytecode is executed. This signature stays a known defect, not a passed intentional compile failure.
